name: FortnitePixelDash17 (R)
author: FDAteam
description: Fly under the gravity portal at 7%, hold out of the level between a block and a slope and release to not die to an invisible saw. Fly above the level and start holding at 17% to avoid invisible blue pads. Stop clicking when the camera goes static at 40%. Start holding at 48% and when the camera goes back to normal fly near the ceiling until the level ends at 71%.
